items.title: Fix silent anchor failure in council/bus.py
items.why_now: Corrupt anchor file silently disables truncation detection, allowing undetected data corruption. This is a core integrity issue.

steps.do: In read_anchor, add logging when JSONDecodeError occurs instead of silently returning None.
steps.verified_by: Create corrupt anchor file, run verify_chain, observe log message about corrupt anchor.

steps.do: In verify_chain, when read_anchor returns None, raise an exception or at least log a warning to ensure truncation detection is not silently disabled.
steps.verified_by: Run verify_chain with corrupt anchor, observe error or warning instead of silent skip.

items.assumption: Changing behavior to raise an exception may break callers that expect silent skip; we assume that is acceptable for integrity.

steps.do: Inspect Ollama provider's _run_rewrite method to see if it checks lane before writing files.
